# Volt Business Solutions

> Volt Business Solutions builds custom business systems with an intelligence layer for business operations, reporting, and automation.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://vbs.lk/): Overview of Volt Business Solutions, its services, capabilities, and product demos.
- [Careers](https://vbs.lk/apply): Career opportunities and application information.
- [Contact](mailto:info@vbs.lk): Contact Volt Business Solutions.

## Services and capabilities

- [Services](https://vbs.lk/#services): Business intelligence, workflow automation, and natural-language business insights.
- [Core capabilities](https://vbs.lk/#features): Custom software, POS and retail systems, inventory management, HR and payroll, BI dashboards, AI agents, integrations, and secure infrastructure.
- [Volt Rewards](https://vbs.lk/#rewards): Customer loyalty and rewards program.
- [Interactive prototype](https://vbs.lk/#prototype): Interactive point-of-sale and business-intelligence dashboard demos.
